findings.title: Registered metric-alert handler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now inherits `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of its required abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Because `MetricAlertFire.detector_handler` points at this class, resolving `Detector.detector_handler` for a detector of this type calls `MetricAlertDetectorHandler(self)` and raises `TypeError` instead of returning a handler. Either retain a concrete no-op handler until metric alerts are implemented or implement all required methods.
